chunks: And in the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Al-Ahwal, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, he said: I heard him saying:
Women do not inherit anything from real estate, but they are entitled to the value of buildings, trees, and palm trees.

key_terms.النَّخْلِ: palm trees as inheritable valued property

ai.seo_question: Do women inherit land itself, or only the value of buildings and trees, in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling on inheritance: women do not inherit from the land itself, while they do receive the assessed value of built structures and planted growth upon it. The report is relevant to discussions of inheritance law and the classification of immovable property in Shi'i fiqh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5750 - In the narration of Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Al-Ahwal from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), he said:
"I heard Imam (as) say: '
Women do not inherit anything from real estate, but they are entitled to the value of buildings, trees, and palm trees.'"
